rounds.method_summary: Fits a regularized histogram gradient boosting model to calibration residuals using sensor identity, traffic level, anchor disagreement, recent-history statistics, horizon and clock, then adds the predicted correction to the upstream forecast. The complete protected MAE is 14.1452638897 (seeds 17, 29, 43), improving identity 15.4218571566; network-context and longer-boosting variants were rejected. Actual mean MAE 14.145263889696942; retained as best.

Blends partially pooled short/long-horizon median residual trees with a small sensor-embedding NumPy network trained on smooth absolute error; both use local history and learned sensor-neighborhood context, and the network adds periodic clock features and a linear correction path. Complete protected MAE is 14.0354537227 for seeds 17, 29 and 43, improving horizon trees 14.1101708074, so the 75% tree / 25% network blend is retained. Method scoring failed; original CLI and verifier output preserved.

rounds.method_summary: Blends partially pooled horizon residual trees with a sensor-embedding NumPy residual network using learned neighborhood context and periodic clock features. Adds horizon-dependent and learned-neighbor signed expert disagreement to the graph-regularized sensor blend gate over median residual trees and a graph-seasonal residual network. rounds.method_summary: Learns diffusion neighbors from seasonally detrended, scale-normalized out-of-fold network innovations while retaining the history-trend gate and bounded residual diffusion. The complete protected seeds 17/29/43 passed all gates and improved masked MAE from 13.906717605638235 to 13.903431941524218, so this graph is retained. Actual mean MAE 13.903431941524218; retained as best.

Selects diffusion neighbors by median seasonally detrended innovation correlation across three out-of-fold origin blocks, preserving pooled sensor scales, history-trend gating and bounded residual diffusion. Complete protected seeds 17/29/43 improved masked MAE from 13.903431941524218 to 13.902411027727524, so median edges are retained; median within-block scaling worsened MAE to 13.905305723647922 and was reverted. Actual mean MAE 13.902411027727524; retained as best.

Selects innovation diffusion edges with mean correlation minus across-block standard deviation, then blends each sensor toward the history graph according to positive support on its selected eight edges. The corrected complete protected seeds 17/29/43 reached masked MAE 13.902094246542314 versus 13.902411027727524 for median edges, so the confidence fallback is retained; an earlier all-edge support implementation scored 13.903352477641612 and was rejected. Actual mean MAE 13.902094246542314; retained as best.
